subject.title: [Feature]: Fallback approval mode + model attribution in messages

question: Should OpenClaw core add a default-off per-agent approval gate before automatic model fallback, and what approval delivery, timeout, fail/proceed, and resume semantics should it use?
rationale: The remaining request is not a broken current contract; it adds config surface and changes provider fallback policy, so automation cannot choose the permanent behavior safely.

options.title: Define Core Fallback Approval
options.body: Add a default-off per-agent fallback approval contract after specifying delivery route, timeout behavior, docs, and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep Automatic Fallback Only
options.body: Close the direction as out of scope and rely on existing fallback notices plus `messages.responsePrefix` for transparency.

options.title: Defer To External Orchestration
options.body: Leave core fallback behavior unchanged and document that users needing pre-provider-change approval should orchestrate model choice outside the fallback loop.

recommendation.title: Define Core Fallback Approval
recommendation.body: Add a default-off per-agent fallback approval contract after specifying delivery route, timeout behavior, docs, and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest central history on model fallback policy and docs among the reviewed paths.
